title: Exquisite Marble Mortar and Pestle Set - Your Ultimate Kitchen Essential for Grinding Spices, Making Guacamole, Salsa, Pesto, and Crushing Pills (Oceanic, Oval Shape (2.5"))
description:
About this item
Dimensions: 5x5 Mortar and Pestle Set crafted from durable mortar pastel stone, ideal for grinding spices, herbs, and more with precision and ease.
Beautifully designed: Mortar and Pestle Set, featuring natural variations in color and texture. This large mortar and pestle set adds elegance to your kitchen while offering superior functionality.
Perfect Size: This large Mortar and Pestle Set offers the ideal size for grinding with ease. The long pestle provides extra control, making it more comfortable for crushing spices and herbs
100% Natural Marble: Crafted from premium marble, this marble mortar and pestle set is made of 100% natural marble for best durability and strength. The mortar pastel stone ensures long-lasting use
MAKE FRESH GUACAMOLE, PESTO, SPICES & MORE!: With the Marble Hives Marble Mortar and Pestle Set, you can quickly create fresh guacamole, pesto, salsas, and ground spices in minutes.

(Thought it would be a little bigger though.)It is the perfect thing for crushing my dogs medecine.I love this set. I use it every day and I think it's beautiful! Phyl pPerfect! Exactly what I wanted and exactly as described.Well craftedGreat for crushing small items.A fantastic product - sturdy, high quality, and the stone is nice with natural variances. Plus the padding on the bottom helps this product not damage delicate surfaces.Carved from real marble, not mixed and poured. Smooth as glass inside and out, and the pestle is too. I discovered, quite by accident, that I don't have to use the pestle it came with. Instead, I used the handle of a small tool I had. The handle is cheap plastic, and fits into the curve of the mortar perfectly. I just 'stir' 'round & 'round and side to side, against the side bottom curve as I tip it slightly, and the pills are ground to a fine powder in no time at all, literally, without ANY effort. The more different pill grinding tools I try, the more I LOVE this one.I was only using it to grind pills to give meds to my dog. The mortar broke in a week or so. A waste of money.
